description: The target is visible, but it is not always possible to shoot it down - the monitoring channels showed how air defense works. As the monitors explain, the detection of a drone does not mean the possibility of its immediate destruction. Between the appearance of the target on the screen and the interception, it is necessary to determine the type of UAV and its route, find a suitable means of defeat and choose a safe moment for the attack. Therefore, the drone can fly...
description_en: The target is visible, but it is not always possible to shoot it down - the monitoring channels showed how air defense works. As the monitors explain, the detection of a drone does not mean the possibility of its immediate destruction. Between the appearance of the target on the screen and the interception, it is necessary to determine the type of UAV and its route, find a suitable means of defeat and choose a safe moment for the attack. Therefore, the drone can fly...
